brief:
Israeli forces abducted thirteen Palestinians, including a father and son, during invasions across the West Bank on Monday, IMEMC News reported. Another father and son were injured during a home search. The operations were part of a broader pattern of military activity in the occupied territory.

Israeli settlers also conducted attacks across the West Bank during the same period, according to the report.
dek: Israeli forces abducted thirteen Palestinians, including a father and son, during West Bank invasions on Monday and injured another father and son during a home search. Israeli colonizers also carried out further attacks across the occupied territory.
title: Israeli forces abduct 13 Palestinians during West Bank raids
